facts: Soil cores are taken at 12 sites from 800 to 2,600 metres at 200-metre steps.
Each core is 10 cm deep and is split into three subsamples.
Sampling window is the last two weeks of July to avoid snow cover.
DNA is extracted with the PowerSoil kit and sequenced on the in-house short-read machine.
Field team is Chiara Bellandi, Joao Pereira and two undergraduates; the permit number is DOL-2026-114.

notes.title: Ember Live-Cell Imaging Archive
notes.description: Time-lapse microscopy dataset of fibroblast migration
facts: Contains 48,000 TIFF frames from 96 wells, captured every 10 minutes for 72 hours.
Stored on server nas-02 under /archive/ember, 3.1 TB in total.
Segmentation masks were produced with a U-Net model, version 2.4, by Beatriz Quintanilla.
Dataset is embargoed until the Ember paper is accepted; do not share outside the lab.
Wells A1 to A6 are excluded because of focus drift.

queries.text: How much disk space does the Ember collection take up?
Why were some plate positions left out of Ember?
¿Quién generó las máscaras de segmentación?

notes.title: Tidewater Sediment Core Chemistry Table
notes.description: Geochemical measurements from estuary sediment cores, 2019 to 2024
facts: Holds 3,412 rows covering lead, zinc, copper and organic carbon at 2 cm depth intervals.
Lead values before 2021 were measured with an older ICP instrument and carry a correction factor of 1.07.
Owner is Marit Haugland and updates are logged in the file CHANGELOG.txt.
Public release on Zenodo is planned for 1 March 2027 under a CC-BY licence.
Missing values are coded as -999, not left blank.

queries.text: What multiplier must be applied to the early toxic-metal readings in Tidewater?
How are absent entries flagged in the Tidewater spreadsheet?
¿Cuándo se publicará el conjunto de datos en Zenodo?

notes.title: Vesper Bat Acoustic Recordings
notes.description: Ultrasonic recordings of bat echolocation from 40 recorder stations in Gelderland
facts: Recorders sample at 384 kHz and write 16-bit WAV files, roughly 11 GB per night.
Season ran from 1 April to 31 October 2025; 1.9 million files total.
Species labels come from the BatID classifier with a confidence threshold of 0.85.
Raw audio is kept on tape in the library basement; only the labelled 5 percent subset lives on the server.
Data steward is Oksana Melnychenko, who must approve any external access request.

queries.text: What is the minimum certainty for assigning an animal type in Vesper?
Where is the unprocessed sound material for Vesper archived?
¿Quién debe aprobar las solicitudes de acceso externo a estos datos?

notes.title: Bacterial Swarm Hysteresis Manuscript
notes.description: Draft paper on hysteresis in bacterial swarming, targeting Cascadia Biophysics Letters
facts: First author is Dmitri Voskresensky; corresponding author is Dr. Yara Benitez.
Submitted to Cascadia Biophysics Letters on 14 September 2026 as manuscript CBL-26-0482.
Reviewers asked for a control with a non-motile mutant and three extra replicates; revision due 20 December 2026.
Word limit is 6,000 including references, and the draft is currently 6,450 words.
Figure 3 must be redrawn in a colour-blind-safe palette.

By what date should we send the amended version of the article on microbe crowds back to the editors?
¿Cuántas palabras tiene actualmente el borrador sobre el enjambre bacteriano?

notes.title: Lisbon Congress Poster Abstract
notes.description: Poster abstract on sleep loss in cavefish submitted to the Lisbon Neuroethology Congress
facts: Abstract limit is 250 words and the current text is 243 words.
Submission closes 8 January 2027 at 23:59 Lisbon time.
Presenting author is Joao Pereira; the poster board is 90 cm wide by 120 cm tall.
Registration fee of 340 euros is paid from the department travel fund.
Notification of acceptance is expected by 15 March 2027.

notes.title: Peer Review Assignment JAME-2291
notes.description: Referee request for a manuscript on permafrost methane from the Journal of Applied Microbial Ecology
facts: Report is due 2 November 2026 and the handling editor is Dr. Rosalind Achterberg.
Review is single-blind and must be returned through the ScholarOne portal, never by email.
Manuscript claims a 38 percent rise in methane flux, but the sample size is only nine cores.
Recommended decision so far is major revision, with concerns about the statistics and missing site metadata.
Review is being written by Joao Pereira under the lab mentoring scheme.

notes.description: Three-year national grant of 480,000 euros funding the soil microbiome and sensor work
facts: Interim report is due 31 January 2027 and must be uploaded to the funder portal by grants officer Elodie Marchetti.
Equipment line is capped at 120,000 euros and any item over 15,000 euros needs three quotes.
Unspent personnel funds may not be carried over past 31 December 2027.

notes.title: Helix Seed Fund Proposal
notes.description: Internal 25,000 euro seed grant application for an automated pipetting robot
facts: Application deadline is 4 December 2026 at noon via the faculty research office form.
Maximum award is 25,000 euros and the money must be spent within 12 months.
Proposal needs a two-page narrative and a one-page budget; page limits are strict.
Panel interviews are scheduled for the week of 18 January 2027.

notes.title: Chemical Waste Disposal Rules
notes.description: Lab rules for sorting and collecting hazardous liquid waste
facts: Halogenated and non-halogenated solvents go into separate 10-litre carboys, labelled with the date of first use.
Carboys are collected by facilities every Wednesday at 8:30; anything not at the door by then waits a week.
Never pour ethidium bromide or acrylamide gels down the drain; use the yellow bin in room C015.
Containers must be closed with a screw cap, not parafilm or foil.
Waste log sheet must be signed by the person who filled the carboy; unsigned carboys are refused.

queries.text: When do the porters come to take away the jugs of toxic leftovers?
What is the right way to seal a bottle of nasty fluids?
¿Dónde se desechan los geles de acrilamida?

notes.title: Data Backup Policy
notes.description: Rules for how raw data is copied, labelled and retained on lab servers
facts: Every raw file needs three copies on two media types with one copy off site, the 3-2-1 rule.
The nightly backup to nas-03 starts at 02:00 and failure alerts go to sysadmin Pavel Horvath.
Raw data must be retained for ten years after publication.
Laptops may not be the only holder of unpublished data; sync to the server weekly.
File names follow YYYYMMDD_initials_experiment_runNN, with no spaces.

queries.text: How long should original measurements be kept after the article comes out?
What format should the titles of my documents take?
¿A qué hora empieza la copia de seguridad nocturna?

notes.title: Reading Note: Tanaka-Whitlock on Phage Resistance
notes.description: Notes on a review article about bacteriophage resistance mechanisms by Tanaka and Whitlock
facts: Review catalogues 14 anti-phage defence systems and argues that most are horizontally transferred.
Key claim: CRISPR accounts for under 10 percent of observed resistance in wild isolates.
Figure 4 table of defence-island sizes is worth copying into our introduction.
Weakness: all isolates come from hospital sewage, so the sample is biased.
Read by Yara Benitez on 6 October 2026; follow-up reading is Vasquez and Ito 2025.

queries.text: What fraction of the immunity in natural strains is attributable to the gene-editing machinery, per Tanaka-Whitlock?
What is the main criticism of where the specimens were obtained, according to Tanaka-Whitlock?
